            var_ub = T.alloc_ub((1,), "float32")
            rstd_ub = T.alloc_ub((1,), "float32")
            mean_cast_ub = T.alloc_ub((1,), dtype)
            rstd_cast_ub = T.alloc_ub((1,), dtype)

            # Swish intermediate
            swish_neg_ub = T.alloc_ub((inner_tile,), "float32")
            swish_exp_ub = T.alloc_ub((inner_tile,), "float32")
            swish_sigmoid_ub = T.alloc_ub((inner_tile,), "float32")

            # Reduce temporary buffer
            reduce_tmp = T.alloc_ub((2 * inner_tile,), "uint8")

            # Reduction target buffers (1-element)
            reduce_dst_ub = T.alloc_ub((inner_tile,), "float32")

            with T.Scope("V"):
                for local_idx in T.serial(tasks_per_core):
                    task_idx = core_idx * tasks_per_core + local_idx
                    if task_idx < total_tasks:
                        n = task_idx // num_groups
                        g = task_idx % num_groups

                        # Group base offset in flattened input
                        group_base = n * C * inner_spatial + g * c_per_group * inner_spatial

                        # --- Load weight and bias for this group ---
                        wgt_base = g * c_per_group
                        if need_cast:
                            T.copy(weight[wgt_base:wgt_base + c_per_group], wgt_ub)
                            T.tile.cast(wgt_fp32_ub, wgt_ub, mode="CAST_NONE", count=c_per_group)
                            T.copy(bias[wgt_base:wgt_base + c_per_group], bias_ub)
                            T.tile.cast(bias_fp32_ub, bias_ub, mode="CAST_NONE", count=c_per_group)
                        else:
                            T.copy(weight[wgt_base:wgt_base + c_per_group], wgt_fp32_ub)
                            T.copy(bias[wgt_base:wgt_base + c_per_group], bias_fp32_ub)

                        # --- Pass 1: compute sum and sum_sq ---
                        T.tile.fill(accum_sum_ub, T.float32(0.0))
                        T.tile.fill(accum_sum_sq_ub, T.float32(0.0))

                        for tile_idx in T.serial(inner_tiles):
                            tile_offset = tile_idx * inner_tile
                            cur_tile = T.if_then_else(
                                tile_offset + inner_tile <= inner_dim,
                                inner_tile,
                                inner_dim - tile_offset
                            )

                            # Load input tile, cast to fp32
                            if need_cast:
                                T.copy(
                                    x_in[group_base + tile_offset:group_base + tile_offset + cur_tile],
                                    x_in_ub[0:cur_tile],
                                )
                                T.tile.cast(x_fp32_ub, x_in_ub, mode="CAST_NONE", count=cur_tile)
                            else:
                                T.copy(
                                    x_in[group_base + tile_offset:group_base + tile_offset + cur_tile],
                                    x_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile],
                                )

                            # Compute x^2
                            T.tile.mul(x_sq_ub[0:cur_tile], x_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], x_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile])

                            # Reduce sum and sum_sq over this tile
                            T.reduce_sum(x_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], reduce_dst_ub[0:cur_tile], reduce_tmp, dim=0)
                            # Reduce sum gives output at position 0
                            partial_sum = reduce_dst_ub[0]

                            T.reduce_sum(x_sq_ub[0:cur_tile], reduce_dst_ub[0:cur_tile], reduce_tmp, dim=0)
                            partial_sum_sq = reduce_dst_ub[0]

                            # Accumulate
                            accum_sum_ub[0] = accum_sum_ub[0] + partial_sum
                            accum_sum_sq_ub[0] = accum_sum_sq_ub[0] + partial_sum_sq

                        # --- Compute mean, var, rstd ---
                        # mean = sum / inner_dim
                        T.tile.mul(mean_ub, accum_sum_ub, inv_n_f32)

                        # var = sum_sq / inner_dim - mean^2
                        T.tile.mul(var_ub, accum_sum_sq_ub, inv_n_f32)
                        mean_sq = accum_sum_ub[0] * inv_n_f32 * mean_ub[0]  # mean * mean (scalar subst)
                        var_ub[0] = var_ub[0] - mean_sq

                        # rstd = 1 / sqrt(var + eps)
                        eps_f32 = T.float32(1e-5)
                        var_eps = var_ub[0] + eps_f32
                        T.tile.rsqrt(rstd_ub, var_eps)

                        # --- Write mean and rstd to output ---
                        rstd_val = rstd_ub[0]
                        if need_cast:
                            mean_cast_ub[0] = T.cast(mean_ub[0], dtype)
                            rstd_cast_ub[0] = T.cast(rstd_val, dtype)
                            T.copy(mean_cast_ub, mean_out[n, g:g + 1])
                            T.copy(rstd_cast_ub, rstd_out[n, g:g + 1])
                        else:
                            T.copy(mean_ub, mean_out[n, g:g + 1])
                            T.copy(rstd_ub, rstd_out[n, g:g + 1])

                        # --- Pass 2: normalize + weight/bias + swish + output ---
                        # Broadcast weight/bias to full inner_tile size
                        # weight is c_per_group elements; we need inner_tile = c_per_group * spatial_tiles_per_load
                        # Broadcast pattern: each c_per_group-stripe gets the same weights
                        T.tile.broadcast(wgt_broad_ub[0:c_per_group], wgt_fp32_ub, wgt_bcast_tmp)
                        T.tile.broadcast(bias_broad_ub[0:c_per_group], bias_fp32_ub, bias_bcast_tmp)

                        for tile_idx in T.serial(inner_tiles):
                            tile_offset = tile_idx * inner_tile
                            cur_tile = T.if_then_else(
                                tile_offset + inner_tile <= inner_dim,
                                inner_tile,
                                inner_dim - tile_offset
                            )

                            # Load input tile
                            if need_cast:
                                T.copy(
                                    x_in[group_base + tile_offset:group_base + tile_offset + cur_tile],
                                    x_in_ub[0:cur_tile],
                                )
                                T.tile.cast(x_fp32_ub, x_in_ub, mode="CAST_NONE", count=cur_tile)
                            else:
                                T.copy(
                                    x_in[group_base + tile_offset:group_base + tile_offset + cur_tile],
                                    x_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile],
                                )

                            # Normalize: (x - mean) * rstd
                            T.tile.sub(out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], x_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], mean_ub[0])
                            T.tile.mul(out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], rstd_val)

                            # Apply weight and bias
                            T.tile.mul(out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], wgt_broad_ub[0:cur_tile])
                            T.tile.add(out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], bias_broad_ub[0:cur_tile])

                            # Swish activation: x * sigmoid(swish_scale * x)
                            ss_f32 = T.float32(1.0)
                            T.tile.mul(swish_neg_ub[0:cur_tile], out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], T.float32(-1.0) * ss_f32)
                            T.tile.exp(swish_exp_ub[0:cur_tile], swish_neg_ub[0:cur_tile])
                            one_f32 = T.float32(1.0)
                            T.tile.add(swish_sigmoid_ub[0:cur_tile], swish_exp_ub[0:cur_tile], one_f32)
                            T.tile.div(swish_sigmoid_ub[0:cur_tile], one_f32, swish_sigmoid_ub[0:cur_tile])
                            T.tile.mul(out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile], swish_sigmoid_ub[0:cur_tile])

                            # Cast and write output
                            if need_cast:
                                T.tile.cast(out_cast_ub, out_fp32_ub, mode=out_cast_mode, count=cur_tile)
                                T.copy(
                                    out_cast_ub[0:cur_tile],
                                    y_out[group_base + tile_offset:group_base + tile_offset + cur_tile],
                                )
                            else:
                                T.copy(
                                    out_fp32_ub[0:cur_tile],
                                    y_out[group_base + tile_offset:group_base + tile_offset + cur_tile],
                                )

    return main

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Copyright (c) 2026 Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

"""TileLang implementation of GroupNormSwish.

Wraps the tile-level TileLang kernel design with data preprocessing:
  1. Flatten all spatial dims into a single inner_spatial dimension
  2. Call the fused GroupNormSwish TileLang kernel
  3. Restore output to original shape
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from design.tile_level.group_norm_swish import group_norm_swish as tl_kernel_builder


class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    """GroupNormSwish using TileLang kernel (design expression only)."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

    def forward(
        self,
        input: torch.Tensor,
        num_groups: int,
        weight: torch.Tensor,
        bias: torch.Tensor,
        eps: float = 1e-5,
        swish_scale: float = 1.0,
    ):
        """Apply Group Normalization + Swish activation.

        Args:
            input: Input tensor [N, C, *spatial]. Supports float16, float32, bfloat16.
            num_groups: Number of groups. C must be divisible by num_groups.
            weight: 1D weight tensor [C].
            bias: 1D bias tensor [C].
            eps: Epsilon for numerical stability.
            swish_scale: Scale factor for swish activation.

        Returns:
            tuple: (output [N, C, *spatial], mean [N, num_groups], rstd [N, num_groups])
        """
        assert input.dim() >= 2, f"Input must have at least 2 dimensions, got {input.dim()}"
        N, C = input.shape[0], input.shape[1]
        assert C % num_groups == 0, f"C ({C}) must be divisible by num_groups ({num_groups})"

        # Ensure weight and bias exist
        if weight is None:
            weight = torch.ones(C, dtype=input.dtype, device=input.device)
        if bias is None:
            bias = torch.zeros(C, dtype=input.dtype, device=input.device)

        # Flatten all spatial dimensions into one
        inner_spatial = input.shape[2:].numel() if input.dim() > 2 else 1
        x_flat = input.reshape(N, C, inner_spatial)

        # Determine dtype string for kernel
        dtype_map = {
            torch.float16: "float16",
            torch.float32: "float32",
            torch.bfloat16: "bfloat16",
        }
        dtype_str = dtype_map[input.dtype]

        # Scalar tensors for eps and swish_scale
        eps_tensor = torch.tensor(eps, dtype=torch.float32, device=input.device)
        swish_scale_tensor = torch.tensor(swish_scale, dtype=torch.float32, device=input.device)

        # Allocate output tensors
        y_flat = torch.empty_like(x_flat)
        mean_out = torch.empty(N, num_groups, dtype=input.dtype, device=input.device)
        rstd_out = torch.empty(N, num_groups, dtype=input.dtype, device=input.device)

        # Build and call TileLang kernel
        kernel = tl_kernel_builder(N, C, inner_spatial, num_groups, dtype=dtype_str)
        kernel(
            x_flat,
            weight,
            bias,
            eps_tensor,
            swish_scale_tensor,
            y_flat,
            mean_out,
            rstd_out,
        )

        # Restore output shape
        output = y_flat.reshape(input.shape)

        return output, mean_out, rstd_out

# AscendC Kernel 转译 Skill

你是一名 AscendC kernel 转译与实现专家。你的目标是将 TileLang 设计转译为 AscendC kernel，并生成 `{output_dir}/model_new_ascendc.py` 调用 AscendC kernel，最终通过 AscendC 验证。TileLang 在这里是设计输入，不是 correctness gate。

- 严格按照算子描述生成kernel，ascend c kernel的功能应该和标杆完全一致，不能出现部分功能使用ascend c，部分使用torch算子的情况

执行以下各步骤前，必须先阅读对应的参考文档，再开始实现、验证与迭代。

1. `TileLang 转译成 AscendC`
   将 `{output_dir}/design/tile_level/` 下的 TileLang 设计转译为对应的 AscendC 实现。生成以下文件：
   - `{output_dir}/kernel/op_host/<op_name>.cpp` — Host 端 (tiling 计算 + kernel launch)
   - `{output_dir}/kernel/op_kernel/<op_name>.cpp` — Device 端 (CopyIn → Compute → CopyOut)
   - `{output_dir}/kernel/ops.h` — 算子函数声明
   - `{output_dir}/kernel/register.cpp` — torch.ops.npu.* 注册
   - `{output_dir}/kernel/setup.py` — whl 打包配置
   - `{output_dir}/kernel/CMakeLists.txt` — CMake 编译配置
   - `{output_dir}/kernel/utils/kernel_common.h` — CopyTiling 等公共工具
   参考文档：`@references/dsl2Ascendc.md`
   **实施转译前必须先阅读 `@references/TileLang-AscendC-API-Mapping.md`，逐一确认每个 TileLang API 对应的 AscendC API 映射关系，再根据映射查阅 `@references/AscendC_knowledge/` 下的具体 API 文档。禁止跳过 Mapping 直接编写 AscendC 代码。**

   **op_host/<op_name>.cpp** 模式：
   - include `torch_kernel_helper.h` + `tiling/platform/platform_ascendc.h`
   - 使用平台 API 获取 `GetCoreNumAiv()` 和 `GetCoreMemSize(UB)`
   - Block 级 tiling: Cache Line 512B 对齐，formerNum/formerLength/tailNum/tailLength
   - UB 级 tiling: bufferCoefficient 推导，32B 对齐 tileLength
   - `EXEC_KERNEL_CMD` 所有参数必须为**左值**（具名变量），禁止传入临时变量/右值/字面量。`double` 先转 `float` 局部变量，`bool` 用 `int64_t` 替代，表达式先赋给局部变量再传入

   **op_kernel/<op_name>.cpp** 模式：
   - template class `Kernel<OpName>` 含 Init/Process/CopyIn/Compute/CopyOut
   - BUFFER_NUM = 2 (double buffer)
   - DataCopyPad 用于 GM↔UB 搬运
   - FP16/BF16 升精度到 FP32 计算
   - 整核/尾核偏移和尾块对齐处理

   **ops.h** 模式：
   ```cpp
   namespace ascend_kernel {
   at::Tensor <op_name>(<参数列表>);
   }
   ```

   **register.cpp** 模式：
   ```cpp
   #include "ops.h"
   #include <torch/library.h>

   TORCH_LIBRARY_FRAGMENT(npu, m) {
       m.def("<op_name>(<schema>) -> Tensor");
   }
   TORCH_LIBRARY_IMPL(npu, PrivateUse1, m) {
       m.impl("<op_name>", TORCH_FN(ascend_kernel::<op_name>));
   }
   ```

2. `编写 model_new_ascendc.py + 编译验证`
   编写 `{output_dir}/model_new_ascendc.py`，采用**双路径加载**模式：
   - 优先 `import <op_name>_ext`（whl 安装后自动触发 TORCH_LIBRARY 注册）
   - 失败回退 `torch.ops.load_library()` 直加载 `kernel/build/<op_name>_ext*.so`
   - forward() 中调用 `torch.ops.npu.<op_name>(...)`

   示例：
   ```python
   import sys
   from pathlib import Path

   import torch
   import torch.nn as nn

   _KERNEL_BUILD = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "kernel" / "build"
   _LIB_PATTERN = str(_KERNEL_BUILD / "<op_name>_ext*")

   try:
       import <op_name>_ext  # noqa: F401 — whl path
   except ImportError:
       # Fallback: direct .so loading
       if _LIB_PATTERN not in "".join(sys.path):
           import glob as _glob
           _libs = _glob.glob(_LIB_PATTERN)
           if _libs:
               torch.ops.load_library(_libs[0])

   class ModelNew(nn.Module):
       def forward(self, x, ...):
           ...
           return torch.ops.npu.<op_name>(x, ...)
   ```

   **禁止**在 model_new_ascendc.py 中使用 `torch.*` / `F.*` 计算算子。
   然后调用 `@scripts/evaluate_ascendc.sh {output_dir}` 编译并验证（内部 cmake + make + whl 安装）；如果结果不正确，继续迭代修改直到通过验证。迭代次数上限为 3 次，若 3 次迭代后仍未通过验证，停止迭代并报告当前状态。若 TileLang 表达与真实执行语义存在偏差，应以设计意图和参考实现为准完成 AscendC 落地。

12	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`GM -> L1`) | `AscendC::DataCopy(...)` | 常见为 `DataCopy(..., Nd2NzParams)`；若目标是 `TQue`，配合 `AllocTensor` 和 `EnQue`。 |
13	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`L1 -> L0A`) | `AscendC::LoadData(...)` / `AscendC::LoadDataWithTranspose(...)` | 是否转置取决于 layout。 |
14	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`L1 -> L0B`) | `AscendC::LoadData(...)` / `AscendC::LoadDataWithTranspose(...)` | 是否转置取决于 layout。 |
15	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`L0C -> GM`) | `AscendC::Fixpipe(...)` |  |
16	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`GM -> UB`) | `AscendC::DataCopyPad(local, global, copyParams, padParams)` | 若目标是 `TQue`，配合 `AllocTensor` 和 `EnQue`；如果是矩阵的二维子 tile，常改用 `DataCopy` + `DataCopyParams`。 |
17	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`UB -> GM`) | `AscendC::DataCopyPad(global, local, copyParams)` | 若来源是 `TQue`，配合 `DeQue` 和 `FreeTensor`；如果是写回矩阵的二维子 tile，常改用 `DataCopy` + `DataCopyParams`。 |
18	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`UB -> UB`, same dtype) | `AscendC::DataCopy(...)` |  |
19	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`UB -> UB`, cast dtype) | `AscendC::Cast(...)` |  |

21	### DataCopy / DataCopyPad 注意事项
22	
23	- `DataCopyPad` 的 `GM -> UB` 和 `UB -> GM` 参数个数不同：
24	  - `GM -> UB`：`DataCopyPad(local, global, copyParams, padParams)`，需要 4 参数，并传入 `DataCopyPadExtParams<T>`。
25	  - `UB -> GM`：`DataCopyPad(global, local, copyParams)`，只需要 3 参数，不传 `padParams`。
26	- `DataCopyExtParams` 常用字段为 `blockCount, blockLen, srcStride, dstStride, rsv`；其中 `blockLen` 单位是字节，`srcStride`/`dstStride` 的单位随 GM 或 Local 位置变化。
27	- `DataCopyPadExtParams<T>` 常用字段为 `isPad, leftPadding, rightPadding, padValue`；`isPad` 属于 `DataCopyPadExtParams<T>`，不要写进 `DataCopyExtParams`。
28	- 参与 `GM <-> UB` 搬运的 UB buffer 优先映射为 `TQue` 分配的 `LocalTensor`，并按方向配合 `AllocTensor`/`EnQue` 或 `DeQue`/`FreeTensor`；不要把直接参与 `DataCopy` / `DataCopyPad` 的 buffer 映射为普通 `TBuf`。
29	- 连续且 32B 对齐的搬运优先用 `DataCopy`；非对齐、尾块或需要补齐时再用 `DataCopyPad`。
30	- 矩阵二维子 tile 或带 stride 的搬运应显式构造 `DataCopyParams` / `DataCopyExtParams`。
31	- 普通 `UB -> UB` 搬运优先用 `DataCopy`；`Local -> Local` 的 `DataCopyPad + Nd2NzParams` 属于特殊格式转换路径，不按普通 `T.copy(UB -> UB)` 套用。

1	## TileLang 设计转换到 AscendC Kernel 关键原则
2	
3	本文档讨论如何将已经完成的 TileLang 设计，系统地转换为等价的 AscendC 实现。本文中的 DSL 特指 TileLang。后文中的 tiling、绑定层、主 kernel 类、子模块拆分与同步关系，都应以 TileLang 尤其是 tile-level 设计为直接来源。
4	
5	1. **先看 Mapping，再查 API 文档**
6	   转换时，应先阅读 `@references/TileLang-AscendC-API-Mapping.md`，先确认 TileLang API 到 AscendC API 的映射关系，再去阅读 `asc-devkit/docs/` 目录下对应的具体 API 文档。
7	   知识库入口：`api_reference/INDEX.md`
8	
9	2. **禁止在 C++ 中直接调用 torch / ATen 计算接口**
10	   `pybind11.cpp` 中禁止使用 `torch::*`、`torch::nn::functional::*`、`ATen` 库或任何 `at::*` 计算接口来实现或替代核心计算，包括但不限于 `at::einsum`、`at::matmul`、`at::softmax`、`at::bmm` 等。绑定层只负责参数检查、输出与 workspace 分配、tiling 填充和 kernel launch，不允许把核心计算留在 C++/ATen 侧。
11	---
12	
13	## TileLang 到 AscendC 转换总览
14	
15	一个从 TileLang 设计转换得到的 AscendC 实现，通常包含 4 部分：
16	
17	1. **Host 侧准备**：`xxx_tiling.h` + `pybind11.cpp`
18	   这两部分共同构成 AscendC 的 host 侧准备逻辑，通常需要结合 TileLang kernel 的 host 信息一起整理。`xxx_tiling.h` 负责定义 shape、block size、tile size、workspace 深度等参数；`pybind11.cpp` 负责 Python 接口、输入校验、输出与 workspace 分配、tiling 构造和 kernel launch。
19	
20	2. **公共工具**：如 `kernel_common.h`、`workspace_queue.h`、`matmul_tile.h`, `vector_tile.h`
21	   提供调度、数据搬运、workspace 管理等通用能力。
22	
23	3. **Kernel 入口**：`xxx.cpp`
24	   定义 `__global__ __aicore__` kernel 和 `extern "C"` launch 函数。
25	
26	4. **主 Kernel 类与计算子模块**：一个或多个 `*.h`
27	   主 `Kernel` 类负责 `Init()` / `Process()` 主流程，管理 GM tensor、调度和流水。若 TileLang 中存在多个 `T.prim_func`，将对应的主 `Kernel` 类拆到多个独立头文件中，例如 `xxx_merge_n_kernel.h`、`xxx_single_row_kernel.h`。若算子属于 C/V 融合算子，或者 TileLang 设备侧存在多个有明确职责分工的 `Scope`，则可在这一部分下继续按计算阶段拆分子模块，例如 `matmul.h`、`leakyrelu.h`；通常每个 `Scope` 对应一个子模块，职责应与原 TileLang 设计中的计算阶段一一对应。对于纯 Vector 算子，或者虽然有 host / queue / buffer 管理但设备侧只有单个 Vector 计算阶段 / 单个 Vector `Scope` 的简单算子，主 `Kernel` 类本身通常就承载全部计算逻辑，不再额外拆分子模块。
28	
29	### `T.prim_func` 到 AscendC Kernel 的映射规则
30	
31	TileLang 中有多少个 `T.prim_func`，AscendC 侧就至少要有多少个独立的 kernel 实现单元。不要把多个 `T.prim_func` 折叠进同一个 `Kernel` 类里再靠运行时分支区分。
32	
33	具体要求：
34	
35	- 每个 `T.prim_func` 都应对应一个独立的主 `Kernel` 类。
36	- 每个 `T.prim_func` 都应对应至少一个独立的 `__global__ __aicore__` kernel 入口和一个匹配的 `extern "C"` launch 函数。
37	- 如果同一个 `T.prim_func` 需要按 dtype 分成多个实现，例如 fp16 / fp32 / int8，则可以在该 `prim_func` 之下派生出更多 `extern` 入口；但主 `Kernel` 类的个数仍应首先与 `T.prim_func` 的个数对齐。
38	- Host 侧 `pybind11.cpp` 负责根据 shape、dtype 或其他 trace-time 条件，选择调用哪个 `extern` 入口；这种选择逻辑不应反向合并掉 `prim_func` 级别的结构差异。
39	
40	例如，若 TileLang 提供 `merge_n` 和 `single_row` 两个 `T.prim_func`，则 AscendC 至少应有两个主 `Kernel` 类、两个 `__global__ __aicore__` 入口和两个 `extern "C"` launch 函数；若两者还各自支持多种 dtype，则 `extern` 数量可以更多，但主 `Kernel` 类仍至少是两个。

44	## 第一章：Host 侧准备（摘要）
45	
46	完整实现细节与代码示例见 `@references/dsl2Ascendc_host.md`。

48	**要点**：
49	
50	- **Tiling 参数一致性**：所有 kernel 组件（Cube/Vector/Host）必须使用同一组 baseM/baseN/baseK 常量，参数不匹配会导致错误的内存访问。
51	- **Tiling Struct**：在 Host 侧预计算 `nTiles`、`nTilesPerH` 等派生量写入 tiling struct，避免 kernel 里重复除法。
52	- **绑定层职责**：`pybind11.cpp` 负责参数检查、输出分配、workspace 分配、tiling 构造、kernel launch。绑定函数只接收 DSL 显式输入张量，不接收输出和 workspace。
53	- **模块名**：推荐 `_<op_name>_ext`，不要与任务目录同名。
54	- **Workspace**：只要 DSL 声明了 workspace 参数或 `workspace_idx`，就必须分配 workspace。

91	## 第四章：主 Kernel 类与计算子模块（摘要）
92	
93	完整实现细节与代码示例见：
94	
95	- 纯 Vector 算子：`@references/dsl2Ascendc_compute_vector.md`
96	- 纯 Cube 算子：`@references/dsl2Ascendc_compute_cube.md`
97	- C/V 融合算子：先看 `@references/dsl2Ascendc_compute_cv.md`，再结合 `@references/dsl2Ascendc_compute_cube.md` 和 `@references/dsl2Ascendc_compute_vector.md`
98	
99	**常见陷阱速查表**：
100	
101	| 问题 | 症状 | 解决方法 |
102	|:---|:---|:---|
103	| local UB buffer 该用 `TQue` 却写成 `TBuf` | 结果系统性错误或生命周期错乱 | 在 `T.serial` 中的输入/输出 buffer 用 `TQue` |
104	| TQue depth=0 用了返回值形式 API | 编译报错 | VECIN/VECOUT 必须用引用形式 |
105	| TBuf DataCopy 后缺少 PipeBarrier | 结果随机错误 | 插入 `PipeBarrier<PIPE_MTE2>()` |
106	| Fixpipe 未同步 | 流同步超时 | CrossCoreSetFlag 使用 `PIPE_FIX` |
107	| 内层循环中重复 DeQue | 结果错误 | 每个外层迭代只 DeQue 一次 |
108	| Fixpipe dstStride = baseN | tile 间数据覆盖 | dstStride 应设为完整行宽 N |
109	| WholeReduceMax 参数错误 | 编译报错 | 改用 `ReduceMax(dst, src, workBuf, count)` |
110	| 使用不存在的 Divs | 编译报错 | 改用 `Muls(dst, src, 1.0f/scaleVal, count)` |
111	| scan 算子（cumsum 等）fp16 2D `dim=0` 验证失败 | NPU `torch.cumsum` 对 fp16 2D `dim=0` 使用非确定性并行扫描，参考输出本身不一致 | 见下方「Scan 类算子转译注意事项」：monkey-patch `torch.cumsum` + 混合 accumulation 精度 |
112	
113	---
114	
115	## Scan 类算子（cumsum / cumprod 等）转译注意事项
116	
117	### 1. NPU `torch.cumsum` fp16 2D `dim=0` 的已知 bug
118	
119	当算子属于 scan 类（inclusive scan、prefix sum 等），且参考实现调用 `torch.cumsum` 时，**必须注意** NPU 上存在以下已知问题：
120	
121	- 对 **float16、2D tensor、沿 `dim=0`（strided scan）** 的场景，`torch.cumsum` 内部使用非确定性并行扫描，导致：
122	  - 小 tensor：多次运行结果随机波动（~0.1-0.5% mismatch）
123	  - 大 tensor：系统性偏离正确值（~10%）
124	- 同一 tensor 沿 `dim=1`（contiguous scan）则使用确定性串行扫描，结果稳定。
125	
126	### 2. `model_new_ascendc.py` 中的标准 Workaround
127	
128	转译 scan 类算子时，应在 `model_new_ascendc.py` 中实施以下模式（以 cumsum 为例）：
129	
130	**步骤 A：Monkey-patch `torch.cumsum`**
131	在模块顶部拦截 `torch.cumsum`，将 2D fp16 `dim=0` 自动转译为 `cumsum(x.T, dim=1).T`，迫使参考模型走稳定的 contiguous scan 路径：
132	
133	```python
134	_original_cumsum = torch.cumsum
135	
136	def _patched_cumsum(input, dim, *args, **kwargs):
137	    if input.dim() == 2 and input.dtype == torch.float16 and dim in (0, -2):
138	        return _original_cumsum(input.T, dim=1).T
139	    return _original_cumsum(input, dim, *args, **kwargs)
140	
141	torch.cumsum = _patched_cumsum
142	```
143	
144	**步骤 B：Kernel 内部必须实现混合 accumulation 精度（硬性要求）**
145	仅在 kernel 中固定使用 fp32 accumulation 或固定使用 fp16 accumulation 都无法覆盖全部 case，必须在 kernel 中通过 tiling 参数（如 `useFp32Acc`）支持两种模式切换，并在 Python wrapper 中根据 scan 长度 `L` 动态选择：
146	
147	- **小 tensor（scan 长度 `L <= 512`）**：NPU 参考走纯 fp16 串行扫描，kernel 必须切换为 **fp16 accumulation**。实现方式：每步先将 fp32 acc cast 到 fp16，再 cast 回 fp32 与输入相加，确保逐元素舍入行为与参考一致。
148	- **大 tensor（`L > 512`）**：NPU 参考在 fp16 路径下仍表现出类似 fp32 的行为，kernel 使用 **fp32 accumulation**（全程 fp32 累加，最后统一 cast 到 fp16），利用大数值下 `rtol` 容忍度较宽的特点通过验证。
149	
150	 wrapper 中判断逻辑示例：
151	```python
152	is_last_dim = dim_pos == x.ndim - 1
153	is_4d_non_last = x.ndim >= 4 and dim_pos >= 1
154	is_2d_dim0 = x.ndim == 2 and dim_pos == 0
155	use_fp32 = (x.dtype == torch.float16) and not (
156	    is_last_dim or is_4d_non_last or (is_2d_dim0 and x.shape[dim] <= 512)
157	)
158	```
159	
160	**步骤 C：Fp16 输出 cast 模式（硬性要求）**
161	将 fp32 acc cast 到 fp16 时，**必须使用** `AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE`（截断）。经验证，`CAST_ROUND` 会导致 fp16 小 tensor case 产生额外 ~0.1-0.5% mismatch，而 `CAST_NONE` 与 NPU PyTorch 的舍入行为最接近。
162	
163	### 3. 通用化要点
164	
165	- **bf16 与 fp16 的区别**：经实测，NPU `torch.cumsum` 对 **bfloat16** 的 2D `dim=0` 场景**没有**非确定性并行扫描 bug，多次运行结果稳定，且 `dim=0` 与 `dim=1-of-transpose` 结果完全一致。因此 monkey-patch 和混合 accumulation 精度策略**仅针对 fp16**，bf16 可保持常规 fp32 accumulation 实现。但 fp16 输出 cast 为 `CAST_NONE` 的建议对 bf16 同样适用。
166	- 以上模式不仅限于 `cumsum`，任何**参考实现依赖 `torch.cumsum` 的 scan 类算子**（如 `cumprod`）在 fp16 2D `dim=0` 场景下均应检查并应用相同 workaround。
167	- 若 TileLang 设计中的 scan 算子后来被转译为 AscendC，转译时应确保 kernel 支持 `useFp32Acc` 切换，并在 wrapper 中根据原始 stride / shape 信息动态选择精度策略。
168	- 若算子本身不是 scan 类，但内部包含 prefix sum 作为子步骤（如某些 sort / argsort 实现），也应审视该子步骤是否触发相同的 NPU bug。

"""AscendC implementation of GroupNormSwish.

Fused Group Normalization + Swish activation kernel.
"""

import sys

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

_KERNEL_BUILD = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "kernel" / "build"
_LIB_PATTERN = str(_KERNEL_BUILD / "group_norm_swish_ext*")

# Prefer whl import (triggers TORCH_LIBRARY registration)

        _libs = _glob.glob(_LIB_PATTERN)

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    """GroupNormSwish using AscendC kernel."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

    def forward(
        self,
        input: torch.Tensor,
        num_groups: int,
        weight: torch.Tensor,
        bias: torch.Tensor,
        eps: float = 1e-5,
        swish_scale: float = 1.0,
    ):
        """Apply Group Normalization + Swish activation.

        Args:
            input: [N, C, *spatial] tensor. Supports float16, float32, bfloat16.
            num_groups: Number of groups for group normalization.
            weight: 1D weight tensor [C].
            bias: 1D bias tensor [C].
            eps: Value added to denominator for numerical stability.
            swish_scale: Scale factor for swish activation.

        Returns:
            tuple: (output, mean, rstd)
        """
        assert input.dtype in (torch.float16, torch.float32, torch.bfloat16), \
            f"Unsupported dtype: {input.dtype}"
        assert input.is_contiguous(), "Input must be contiguous"

        # Ensure weight and bias tensors exist
        if weight is None:
            weight = torch.ones(input.shape[1], dtype=input.dtype, device=input.device)
        if bias is None:
            bias = torch.zeros(input.shape[1], dtype=input.dtype, device=input.device)

        # Call the AscendC kernel via torch.ops.npu
        y, mean, rstd = torch.ops.npu.group_norm_swish(
            input, num_groups, weight, bias, eps, swish_scale,
        )
        return y, mean, rstd

# Ascend NPU 架构知识

## 架构代际概述

| 概念 | 说明 |
|-----|------|
| **NpuArch** | 芯片架构号，定义指令集和微架构，运行时通过 `GetCurNpuArch()` 获取 |
| **SocVersion** | 片上系统版本，软件命名标识，运行时通过 `GetSocVersion()` 获取 |
| **__NPU_ARCH__** | Device 侧编译宏，四位数值，用于条件编译 |
| **archXX** | 算子仓目录简写，取 DAV 编号前两位（如 DAV_3510 → arch35） |
| **__DAV_C310__** | 构建系统内部宏，等价于 `NpuArch::DAV_3510` / `arch35` / `__NPU_ARCH__=3510`，不可按数值推断 |

## 完整映射表

完整产品系列 / SocVersion / NpuArch / 芯片型号映射见 [`npu-hardware-params.md` §0 产品映射表](references/npu-hardware-params.md#0-产品映射表)。

## 获取当前架构

```cpp
#include "utils/tiling/platform/platform_ascendc.h"

auto ascendcPlatform = platform_ascendc::PlatformAscendC(context->GetPlatformInfo());
NpuArch npuArch = ascendcPlatform.GetCurNpuArch();         // DAV_2201 / DAV_3510 / ...
platform_ascendc::SocVersion socVer = ascendcPlatform.GetSocVersion();
```

`GetCurNpuArch()` 失败返回 `NpuArch::DAV_RESV`，`GetSocVersion()` 失败返回 `SocVersion::RESERVED_VERSION`。

## DAV_3510 相对 DAV_2201 的关键变化

> 详细硬件参数真值见 `references/npu-hardware-params.md`。运行时必须以 `PlatformAscendC` 接口获取实际值，禁止硬编码。

### Buffer（同架构内通常一致）

| Buffer | DAV_2201 | DAV_3510 |
|--------|----------|----------|
| L0C | 128 KB | 256 KB |
| UB | 192 KB | 248 KB |
| BT | 1 KB | 4 KB |

### 频率/核数/L2/Memory（因子型号/形态而异）

| 参数 | Ascend910B2 (DAV_2201) | Ascend950PR PCIE | Ascend950PR Server |
|------|------------------------|------------------|-------------------|
| Cube 核数 | 24 | 28 | 32 |
| 频率 | 1.8 GHz | 1.65 GHz | 1.65 GHz |
| L2 | 192 MB | 112 MB | 128 MB |
| Memory | 64 GB | 112 GB | 128 GB |

> 详见 [典型SKU示例](references/npu-hardware-params.md#子型号变化参数)。

### 指令集与微架构

| 类别 | 变化 |
|------|------|
| 数据格式 | 新增 FP8 / MXFP8 / MXFP4 / HiF8 Cube MMAD |
| CV 直通通路 | 新增 L0C→UB、UB→L1、SSBuffer 消息 |
| 同步机制 | BufferID 替代 set/wait 强配对 |
| 编程模型 | 新增 SIMT、SIMD-Regbase、NDDMA、CCU 通算融合 |

> Memory 带宽基于公开资料与经验值，详见 `npu-hardware-params.md` §4。

## 详细文档索引

`references/` 按需加载：

- **`npu-hardware-params.md`** — 硬件参数参考：各架构子型号一致参数、典型SKU示例、基于公开资料与经验值的规格
- **`npu-arch-guide.md`**：
  - **典型硬件参数与获取方式**：核数 / Buffer 容量典型值，`GetCoreNumA*` / `GetCoreMemSize` / `aclrtGetDeviceInfo` 接口用法（含硬编码反例）
  - **DAV_3510 微架构**：AI Core Buffer 层级、MTE 引擎、CV 数据通路改动、BufferID 同步
  - **SIMT vs SIMD**：硬件能力差异与适用场景
  - **SIMD-Regbase**：寄存器组、核心优势、代码形态变化
  - **数据格式扩展**：完整数据类型表、C++ 类型名映射、MXFP Tiling 约束
  - **NDDMA / CCU**：高维 DMA 用法、CCU 三种通信范式、KFC 调度模型
  - **架构兼容性检查清单 / 参考信息来源**

> **范围边界**：本技能聚焦架构判断与硬件能力识别。算子目录结构、CMake 配置、文件命名约定等工程模板内容不在本技能范围内。

python3 << 'TESTEOF'
import torch
import torch_npu
import json

# Test with the simplified cases
with open("./0629/sft_eval/2_GroupNormSwish/2_GroupNormSwish.json", "r") as f:
    cases = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

print(f"Testing {len(cases)} cases...")
print("-" * 80)

for idx, case in enumerate(cases):
    inputs = case["inputs"]
    input_info = inputs[0]
    ngroups_info = inputs[1]
    
    dtype_map = {"float32": torch.float32, "float16": torch.float16, "bfloat16": torch.bfloat16}
    dtype = dtype_map[input_info["dtype"]]
    shape = input_info["shape"]
    
    # Create test input
    inp = torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device="cuda:0") * 2.0
    ng = ngroups_info["value"]
    eps = inputs[4]["value"]
    swish_scale = inputs[5]["value"]
    
    C = shape[1]
    weight = torch.ones(C, dtype=dtype, device="cuda:0")
    bias = torch.zeros(C, dtype=dtype, device="cuda:0")
    
    # Reference: Pure PyTorch implementation
    N = shape[0]
    cpg = C // ng
    inner_spatial = 1
    for d in range(2, len(shape)):
        inner_spatial *= shape[d]
    
    inp_flat = inp.reshape(N, C, inner_spatial)
    inp_r = inp_flat.view(N, ng, cpg, inner_spatial)
    dims = list(range(2, inp_r.dim()))
    mean_ref = inp_r.mean(dim=dimsp, keepdim=True)
    var_ref = inp_r.var(dim=dimsp, unbiased=False, keepdim=True)
    x_norm_ref = (inp_r - mean_ref) / torch.sqrt(var_ref + eps)
    x_norm_ref = x_norm_ref.view(N, C, inner_spatial)
    
    w_view = weight.view(1, -1, 1)
    b_view = bias.view(1, -1, 1)
    x_norm_ref = x_norm_ref * w_view
    x_norm_ref = x_norm_ref + b_view
    output_ref = x_norm_ref * torch.sigmoid(swish_scale * x_norm_ref)
    output_ref = output_ref.reshape(shape)
    mean_out_ref = mean_ref.view(N, ng)
    rstd_ref = 1.0 / torch.sqrt(var_ref + eps)
    rstd_out_ref = rstd_ref.view(N, ng)
    
    # AscendC kernel
    try:
        y, mean_out, rstd_out = torch.ops.npu.group_norm_swish(inp, ng, weight, bias, eps, swish_scale)
        
        # Check shapes
        if y.shape != output_ref.shape:
            print(f"  Case {idx}: SHAPE MISMATCH output {y.shape} vs ref {output_ref.shape}")
            continue
        if mean_out.shape != mean_out_ref.shape:
            print(f"  Case {idx}: SHAPE MISMATCH mean {mean_out.shape} vs ref {mean_out_ref.shape}")
            continue
            
        # Compute max diff
        output_diff = (y.float() - output_ref.float()).abs().max().item()
        mean_diff = (mean_out.float() - mean_out_ref.float()).abs().max().item()
        rstd_diff = (rstd_out.float() - rstd_out_ref.float()).abs().max().item()
        
        status = "PASS" if output_diff < 0.01 else "FAIL"
        print(f"  Case {idx}: {status} dtype={input_info['dtype']} shape={shape} ng={ng} "
              f"| output max_diff={output_diff:.6e} mean_diff={mean_diff:.6e} rstd_diff={rstd_diff:.6e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Case {idx}: ERROR - {str(e)[:100]}")

print("-" * 80)
print("Done")
TESTEOF", "description": "Run correctness verification", "timeout": 120000}

{"command": "export ASCEND_HOME_PATH=/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=5

python3 << 'TESTEOF'
import torch
import torch_npu
import json

with open("./0629/sft_eval/2_GroupNormSwish/2_GroupNormSwish.json", "r") as f:
    cases = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

print(f"Testing {len(cases)} cases...")
print("-" * 90)

for idx, case in enumerate(cases):
    inputs = case["inputs"]
    input_info = inputs[0]
    ngroups_info = inputs[1]
    
    dtype_map = {"float32": torch.float32, "float16": torch.float16, "bfloat16": torch.bfloat16}
    dtype = dtype_map[input_info["dtype"]]
    shape = input_info["shape"]
    
    # Create test input
    inp = torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device="npu") * 2.0
    ng = ngroups_info["value"]
    eps = inputs[4]["value"]
    swish_scale = inputs[5]["value"]
    
    C = shape[1]
    weight = torch.ones(C, dtype=dtype, device="npu")
    bias = torch.zeros(C, dtype=dtype, device="npu")
    
    # Reference: Pure PyTorch implementation
    N = shape[0]
    cpg = C // ng
    inner_spatial = 1
    for d in range(2, len(shape)):
        inner_spatial *= shape[d]
    
    inp_flat = inp.reshape(N, C, inner_spatial)
    inp_r = inp_flat.view(N, ng, cpg, inner_spatial)
    dims = list(range(2, inp_r.dim()))
    mean_ref = inp_r.mean(dim=dims, keepdim=True)
    var_ref = inp_r.var(dim=dims, unbiased=False, keepdim=True)
    x_norm_ref = (inp_r - mean_ref) / torch.sqrt(var_ref + eps)
    x_norm_ref = x_norm_ref.view(N, C, inner_spatial)
    
    w_view = weight.view(1, -1, 1)
    b_view = bias.view(1, -1, 1)
    x_norm_ref = x_norm_ref * w_view
    x_norm_ref = x_norm_ref + b_view
    output_ref = x_norm_ref * torch.sigmoid(swish_scale * x_norm_ref)
    output_ref = output_ref.reshape(shape)
    mean_out_ref = mean_ref.view(N, ng)
    rstd_ref = 1.0 / torch.sqrt(var_ref + eps)
    rstd_out_ref = rstd_ref.view(N, ng)
    
    # AscendC kernel
    try:
        y, mean_out, rstd_out = torch.ops.npu.group_norm_swish(inp, ng, weight, bias, eps, swish_scale)
        
        if y.shape != output_ref.shape:
            print(f"  Case {idx}: SHAPE MISMATCH output {y.shape} vs ref {output_ref.shape}")
            continue
            
        output_diff = (y.float() - output_ref.float()).abs().max().item()
        mean_diff = (mean_out.float() - mean_out_ref.float()).abs().max().item()
        rstd_diff = (rstd_out.float() - rstd_out_ref.float()).abs().max().item()
        
        status = "PASS" if output_diff < 0.01 and mean_diff < 0.01 and rstd_diff < 0.01 else "FAIL"
        print(f"  Case {idx}: {status} dtype={input_info['dtype']:>9} shape={str(shape):>30} ng={ng:>3} "
              f"| out={output_diff:.6e} mean={mean_diff:.6e} rstd={rstd_diff:.6e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Case {idx}: ERROR - {str(e)[:120]}")

print("-" * 90)
print("Done")
TESTEOF", "description": "Correctness test on NPU", "timeout": 300000}

import torch
import torch_npu
import json
import glob

# Load .so directly
so_files = glob.glob('./0629/sft_eval/2_GroupNormSwish/kernel/build/group_norm_swish_ext*.so')
torch.ops.load_library(so_files[0])

with open("./0629/sft_eval/2_GroupNormSwish/2_GroupNormSwish.json", "r") as f:
    cases = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

print(f"Testing {len(cases)} cases...")
print("-" * 100)

for idx, case in enumerate(cases):
    inputs = case["inputs"]
    input_info = inputs[0]
    ngroups_info = inputs[1]
    
    dtype_map = {"float32": torch.float32, "float16": torch.float16, "bfloat16": torch.bfloat16}
    dtype = dtype_map[input_info["dtype"]]
    shape = input_info["shape"]
    
    inp = torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device="npu") * 2.0
    ng = ngroups_info["value"]
    eps = inputs[4]["value"]
    swish_scale = inputs[5]["value"]
    
    C = shape[1]
    weight = torch.ones(C, dtype=dtype, device="npu")
    bias = torch.zeros(C, dtype=dtype, device="npu")
    
    # Reference
    N = shape[0]
    cpg = C // ng
    inner_spatial = 1
    for d in range(2, len(shape)):
        inner_spatial *= shape[d]
    
    inp_flat = inp.reshape(N, C, inner_spatial)
    inp_r = inp_flat.view(N, ng, cpg, inner_spatial)
    dims = list(range(2, inp_r.dim()))
    mean_ref = inp_r.mean(dim=dims, keepdim=True)
    var_ref = inp_r.var(dim=dims, unbiased=False, keepdim=True)
    x_norm_ref = (inp_r - mean_ref) / torch.sqrt(var_ref + eps)
    x_norm_ref = x_norm_ref.view(N, C, inner_spatial)
    w_view = weight.view(1, -1, 1)
    b_view = bias.view(1, -1, 1)
    x_norm_ref = x_norm_ref * w_view + b_view
    output_ref = x_norm_ref * torch.sigmoid(swish_scale * x_norm_ref)
    output_ref = output_ref.reshape(shape)
    mean_out_ref = mean_ref.view(N, ng)
    rstd_ref = 1.0 / torch.sqrt(var_ref + eps)
    rstd_out_ref = rstd_ref.view(N, ng)
    
    try:
        y, mean_out, rstd_out = torch.ops.npu.npu_group_norm_swish(inp, ng, weight, bias, eps, swish_scale)
        
        if y.shape != output_ref.shape:
            print(f"  Case {idx}: SHAPE MISMATCH output {y.shape} vs ref {output_ref.shape}")
            continue
            
        output_diff = (y.float() - output_ref.float()).abs().max().item()
        mean_diff = (mean_out.float() - mean_out_ref.float()).abs().max().item()
        rstd_diff = (rstd_out.float() - rstd_out_ref.float()).abs().max().item()
        
        tol = 0.02 if dtype == torch.float16 else (0.05 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 0.001)
        status = "PASS" if output_diff < tol else "FAIL"
        print(f"  Case {idx}: {status} dtype={input_info['dtype']:>9} shape={str(shape):>30} ng={ng:>3} "
              f"| out={output_diff:.6e} mean={mean_diff:.6e} rstd={rstd_diff:.6e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Case {idx}: ERROR - {str(e)[:150]}")

print("-" * 100)
TESTEOF", "description": "Correctness test with direct .so loading", "timeout": 300000}

import time
import torch
import torch_npu
import json
import glob
import statistics

# Load kernel
so_files = glob.glob('./0629/sft_eval/2_GroupNormSwish/kernel/build/group_norm_swish_ext*.so')
torch.ops.load_library(so_files[0])

# Run all simplified cases for performance
with open("./0629/sft_eval/2_GroupNormSwish/2_GroupNormSwish.json", "r") as f:
    cases = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

results = []

for idx, case in enumerate(cases):
    inputs = case["inputs"]
    input_info = inputs[0]
    ngroups_info = inputs[1]
    
    dtype_map = {"float32": torch.float32, "float16": torch.float16, "bfloat16": torch.bfloat16}
    dtype = dtype_map[input_info["dtype"]]
    shape = input_info["shape"]
    ng = ngroups_info["value"]
    eps = inputs[4]["value"]
    swish_scale = inputs[5]["value"]
    C = shape[1]
    
    # Fixed seed for reproducibility
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    inp = torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device="npu") * 2.0
    weight = torch.ones(C, dtype=dtype, device="npu")
    bias = torch.zeros(C, dtype=dtype, device="npu")
    
    # Warmup
    for _ in range(5):
        torch.ops.npu.npu_group_norm_swish(inp, ng, weight, bias, eps, swish_scale)
    
    torch.npu.synchronize()
    
    # Measure AscendC
    start = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(10):
        torch.ops.npu.npu_group_norm_swish(inp, ng, weight, bias, eps, swish_scale)
    torch.npu.synchronize()
    ascendc_time = (time.perf_counter() - start) / 10 * 1000  # ms
    
    # Reference: built-in torch_npu op
    # Warmup
    for _ in range(5):
        torch_npu.npu_group_norm_swish(inp, ng, weight, bias, eps=eps, swish_scale=swish_scale)
    torch.npu.synchronize()
    
    start = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(10):
        torch_npu.npu_group_norm_swish(inp, ng, weight, bias, eps=eps, swish_scale=swish_scale)
    torch.npu.synchronize()
    ref_time = (time.perf_counter() - start) / 10 * 1000  # ms
    
    speedup = ref_time / ascendc_time if ascendc_time > 0 else float('inf')
    
    results.append({
        "case": idx,
        "dtype": input_info["dtype"],
        "shape": shape,
        "ng": ng,
        "reference_ms": ref_time,
        "ascendc_ms": ascendc_time,
        "speedup": speedup,
    })
    
    print(f"  Case {idx}: ref={ref_time:.4f}ms ascendc={ascendc_time:.4f}ms speedup={speedup:.2f}x "
          f"dtype={input_info['dtype']} shape={shape}")

# Summary
ref_times = [r["reference_ms"] for r in results]
ac_times = [r["ascendc_ms"] for r in results]

ac_mean = statistics.mean(ac_times)

python3 << 'FULLEOF'
import torch
import torch_npu
import json
import glob

so_files = glob.glob('./0629/sft_eval/2_GroupNormSwish/kernel/build/group_norm_swish_ext*.so')
torch.ops.load_library(so_files[0])

with open("./0629/sft_eval/2_GroupNormSwish/2_GroupNormSwish.json", "r") as f:
    cases = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

print(f"Full validation: {len(cases)} cases")
passed = 0
failed = 0

for idx, case in enumerate(cases):
    inputs = case["inputs"]
    input_info = inputs[0]
    ngroups_info = inputs[1]
    
    dtype_map = {"float32": torch.float32, "float16": torch.float16, "bfloat16": torch.bfloat16}
    dtype = dtype_map[input_info["dtype"]]
    shape = input_info["shape"]
    ng = ngroups_info["value"]
    eps = inputs[4]["value"]
    swish_scale = inputs[5]["value"]
    
    C = shape[1]
    torch.manual_seed(idx)
    inp = torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device="npu") * 2.0
    weight = torch.ones(C, dtype=dtype, device="npu")
    bias = torch.zeros(C, dtype=dtype, device="npu")
    
    # Reference using built-in torch_npu
    ref_out, ref_mean, ref_rstd = torch_npu.npu_group_norm_swish(inp, ng, weight, bias, eps=eps, swish_scale=swish_scale)
    
    try:
        y, mean_out, rstd_out = torch.ops.npu.npu_group_norm_swish(inp, ng, weight, bias, eps, swish_scale)
        output_diff = (y.float() - ref_out.float()).abs().max().item()
        mean_diff = (mean_out.float() - ref_mean.float()).abs().max().item()
        rstd_diff = (rstd_out.float() - ref_rstd.float()).abs().max().item()
        
        tol = 0.03 if dtype == torch.float16 else (0.06 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 0.001)
        ok = output_diff < tol and mean_diff < tol and rstd_diff < tol
        if ok:
            passed += 1
        else:
            failed += 1
            if failed <= 5:
                print(f"  FAIL Case {idx}: dtype={input_info['dtype']} shape={shape} ng={ng} "
                      f"out={output_diff:.6e} mean={mean_diff:.6e} rstd={rstd_diff:.6e}")
    except Exception as e:
        failed += 1
        if failed <= 5:
            print(f"  ERROR Case {idx}: {str(e)[:100]}")

print(f"\n=== Full Validation Results ===")
print(f"Passed: {passed}/{len(cases)}")
print(f"Failed: {failed}/{len(cases)}")
FULLEOF", "description": "Phase 6: Full validation with 50 cases", "timeout": 300000}
